AgentDraftCommand.description:
A bounded request for one merchant-facing draft (follow-up or polish).

This is *not* free-form Q&A and grants no execution authority: the draft is
text a merchant reads and then sends through the existing approval path, or
discards. ``base_proposal_id`` reuses text the extraction seam already
produced under its own gates (budget, provenance, time basis); ``text`` is
merchant-written input that the server only stores. Neither turns the model
into a sender.
AgentDraftCommand.title: AgentDraftCommand

AssignMessageCommand.description: Merchant decides an unassigned message: which open order it belongs to, or none.
AssignMessageCommand.title: AssignMessageCommand

ChangeStatus.description: A requirement change: like a field status, plus the merchant's rejection.
ChangeStatus.title: ChangeStatus

DailySummary.description: 方案 §4.6 每日摘要: each entry points at the record it comes from.
DailySummary.title: DailySummary

DeferItemCommand.description: The customer will confirm a key item later; ``until`` defaults to 3 days.
DeferItemCommand.title: DeferItemCommand

DeferredItem.description: A key item the customer said they will confirm later (契约 §3 Customer defers).
DeferredItem.title: DeferredItem

DeliveryChecklist.description: 方案 §4.6 交付前检查: confirmed requirements to check and what is still unfinished.
DeliveryChecklist.title: DeliveryChecklist

DismissSuggestionCommand.description: Merchant discards an AI new-order suggestion: the message is not a new job.
DismissSuggestionCommand.title: DismissSuggestionCommand

EditActionCommand.description: Merchant edits a draft before approving it (new revision and snapshot hash).
EditActionCommand.title: EditActionCommand

InspectWorkOrderCommand.description: Look up an exact completed command; never execute or resubmit it.
InspectWorkOrderCommand.title: InspectWorkOrderCommand

NewWorkOrderSuggestedField.description:
One critical field of a new-work-order suggestion.

``value`` may be ``None`` when the customer has not supplied the field
yet; the field name should then also appear in
:attr:`NewWorkOrderSuggestion.missing_fields`. Suggested values are
drafts bound to their source message revisions. They deliberately carry
no ``field_status`` and no ``customer_confirmation``: a suggestion is
neither a proposal against an existing work order nor any form of
confirmation, so those concepts do not apply.
NewWorkOrderSuggestedField.title: NewWorkOrderSuggestedField

NewWorkOrderSuggestion.description:
Structured draft for creating a NEW work order from a conversation.

Recognition output only: the suggestion never creates a work order,
never marks anything confirmed and grants no execution authority. It
records what the model recognised (critical fields, each bound to its
source message revision), what is still missing, and the questions a
human must resolve before the merchant creates the order manually.
Customer proposal, customer confirmation and merchant approval remain
separate facts, as everywhere else in the contract.
NewWorkOrderSuggestion.title: NewWorkOrderSuggestion

RequirementItem.description: Required material, a promise either side made, or an open question (方案 §4.3).
RequirementItem.title: RequirementItem

ScheduleCheck.description: Deterministic checks for one order's time, plus free slots the merchant may offer.
ScheduleCheck.title: ScheduleCheck

ScheduleSettings.description: User-set working time (方案 §4.4). Buffers are the user's own numbers, not travel time.
ScheduleSettings.title: ScheduleSettings

SendApprovedActionCommand.description:
Merchant hands an approved business reply to the WhatsApp sending gateway.

The connection, control and send-permission versions are the ones the
merchant sees on the sending page; the action revision and snapshot hash
are the exact approved reply.
SendApprovedActionCommand.title: SendApprovedActionCommand

SetWorkOrderStatusCommand.description: Merchant moves an order along its life cycle (see TRANSITIONS in workorders).
SetWorkOrderStatusCommand.title: SetWorkOrderStatusCommand

WorkOrderEvidenceCommand.description:
Merchant decision to keep one reviewed attachment as work-order evidence.

This is a merchant action, not a customer confirmation and not an AI
write: every identity field is echoed from the reviewed evidence the
merchant actually saw, so a newer result or file cannot inherit it.
WorkOrderEvidenceCommand.title: WorkOrderEvidenceCommand

WorkOrderFields.description: Key items (schedule, address) decide confirmation; the others are business detail.
WorkOrderFields.title: WorkOrderFields

WorkspaceCapabilities.description: Release gates, not connector permissions or claims of live acceptance.
WorkspaceCapabilities.title: WorkspaceCapabilities

get.description: Events overlapping [start, end) when given; tentative entries included and marked.
Today's work, waiting items, due soon, decisions and rule-based suggestions (read-only).

post.description:
Take the draft text into the merchant's existing approval flow, once.

Consuming returns the text and marks the draft used; it never sends
anything and never bypasses approval.
Withdraw a draft so it can no longer be consumed.

Create one bounded merchant-facing draft (follow-up or polish).

The text comes either from a proposal the extraction seam already produced
under its own gates, or from the merchant's own input: there is no
free-form question path. A draft is text only — never sent, never
confirming a field, granting no execution authority — and it is limited per
day, expires, can be revoked and can be consumed once.

Keep one reviewed attachment as evidence for this work order.

The reviewed binding (attachment version, context version, result job and
hash) is re-validated before anything is written, and the row snapshots it
so a later change shows up as ``stale`` rather than silently refreshing.

get.description: Risks for this order's time and free slots the merchant may offer (read-only).
